e Example 2: Installation with Load Shape Measurement for Watt-Hour and Reactive Consumption, as well as Check Reading

for Watt-Hour Consumption

Point of Delivery Transaction

You find the point of delivery transactions Create/Change/ Display in the Easy Access Menu under |}*Technical Master Data
Point of Delivery.

The following information describes the individual fields and tab strips.

Group Box for PoD Description

The individual fields have the following functions:

Field/Symbol                                                                               Function
fd History                                                                                    Enables you to display different histories
ia, Header data                                                                              Enables you to return from times slice display to the normal view

EF New time slice

ay.
gia Default value

Valid to

Structure category

Fields of the PoD ID

Header Tab Strip

Field
PoD Description

Point of delivery type

PoD role
Technical PoD

Deregulation PoD

You cannot enter data in the To field. To restrict the validity of the
point of delivery ID, insert a new time slice. To do this, choose New
Time Slice . In the From Day field, enter the date and time at which

you want the new time slice to become valid. The previous time
slice finishes on the start date of the new time slice.

If you use the Metering Code structure category, you can generate
a consecutive number for the point of delivery ID. To do this, choose

the Default Value entry in the Consecutive Number field.

Validity period for the PoD ID

The system automatically proposes the structure category defined
in Customizing as the default value (| Master Data » Point of
Delivery } Define Structure of Point of Delivery ID 4).

Various fields are shown depending on the structure category you
selected

Function
Text that describes the point of delivery

Enables you to select one of the point of delivery types defined in
Customizing.You define point of delivery types in the IMG under
SAP Utilities Master Data Point of DeliveryDefine Point of
Delivery Type.

See the Point of Delivery Roles unit
